answer: I couldn't confirm this. The documents don't say which codename the identity service uses, so no backup-restore template can be tied to it for certain. The Identity service overview doesn't give a codename. The backup-restore runbooks are named by codename: Osprey CHG-9785, Juniper CHG-8595, Tamarack CHG-7260, Cobalt CHG-9478, Thistle CHG-1739 and Wren CHG-9333. Obsidian (CHG-1726) is the reporting service, so it doesn't apply. My best guess is Osprey, CHG-9785, but that is only an inference. Osprey is the only codename that also has a credential-rotation runbook, which would fit an identity service. Please check the codename with the Platform team before you raise the change.
